title: Corriewood Hartsmere 响应运营计划
instruction:
你是中士。巡逻主管奥迪尔·祖贝尔 (Odile Zubair) 正在为科里伍德县治安官办公室准备哈茨米尔诊所 3 月份临床治理会议的唯一书面材料。巡逻队通常每周处理大约二十个行为健康电话，但诊所在下午6之后就没有临床医生了。该委员会两年前拒绝了搭车安排，因为它对员工安全不满意。埃梅卡·库蒂尼奥 (Emeka Coutinho) 已请求批准一项提案，让一名哈茨米尔 (Hartsmere) 危机工作人员在周五和周六晚上参加巡逻队，并由 Wrenfield Associates 审查诊所的安全安排。该运营模式必须在自 2 月 15、2026 起适用的法律和专业界限内在科里伍德县运作。今年，该诊所正在将其社区团队从纸质临床记录转移到电子健康记录，但巡查可能会在更改完成之前启动，因此该文件必须在过渡期间和切换后保持可操作性。该委员会还希望在临床记录所有权、代表认为拘留合法但临床医生反对时出现分歧，或者场景变得暴力时会发生什么情况等方面不存在任何歧义。这些问题需要在运营计划中解决，而不是推迟到以后的政策制定中。
准备`hartsmere_coresponse_proposal.docx`，将审批方案与现场作业计划结合起来，不超过六页，无附录。定义一个完整的操作模型，主管、副手、调度人员、诊所工作人员和临床治理审核员可以使用该模型，而无需联系您进行澄清。委员会成员了解临床治理，而多名巡审员没有临床背景；让两个群体都能接触到它，而不将其变成介绍性行为健康培训或法律备忘录。仅将二十个呼叫数字和之前的拒绝视为有限的背景：不要发明呼叫趋势、结果率、成本、节省、人员配备或研究结果。使用上面的文件名将完成的文件放在工作目录的顶层。必须在 3 月6、2026 之前准备好 Emeka 的包裹。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `hartsmere_coresponse_proposal.docx` — 准备批准的共同响应提案和现场操作计划，用于周五和周六晚上部署一名诊所危机工作人员和巡逻队。 （必须使用确切的文件名hartsmere_coresponse_proposal.docx写入工作目录的顶层。；不得超过六个渲染页。；不得包含附录。；必须解决纸质记录过渡期和电子记录最终状态。；必须可供临床治理审查员和巡逻人员使用，而不会成为行为健康教程或法律备忘录。；不得发明呼叫趋势、结果率、成本、节省、人员可用性或研究结果。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
Hartsmere Co-Response Operating Proposal
Friday and Saturday night patrol-clinic deployment | Submitted by Sgt. Odile Zubair for Emeka Coutinho's March clinical governance packet
Control
Approved operating instrument
Status / purpose
For clinical governance approval as written. Establishes the proposed operating model and field rules for one Hartsmere crisis worker riding with one Corriewood County Sheriff's Office (CCSO) patrol unit.
Proposed service window
Every Friday and Saturday, 18:00-02:00 (the shift begins Friday or Saturday and ends the following morning). Co-response is not available outside this window.
Effective point
Becomes active only after Hartsmere Clinical Governance Committee approval, the CCSO patrol commander's written operational acceptance, and Wrenfield Associates' safety review are recorded by the named owners.
Owners
CCSO Patrol Commander: law-enforcement operations. Hartsmere Clinical Director: clinical practice and clinical records. Dispatch Supervisor: activation practice.
Approval / assurance
Hartsmere Clinical Governance Committee approves or declines this instrument. Wrenfield Associates reviews safety arrangements for the clinic and advises the Clinical Director; it has no field command, record custody, detention authority, or approval authority.
Version
1.0 | prepared 6 March 2026 | review uses the cadence in Section 6.

1. Decision and service boundary
This is a limited co-response service, not a replacement for ordinary patrol, emergency medical response, or routine clinic outreach. Patrol receives about twenty behavioral-health calls in a typical week; that context does not establish demand, outcomes, or staffing need. The proposed service aims to support safer assessment, clearer coordination, voluntary stabilization and referral where appropriate, and lawful, proportionate action when safety requires it.
In scope when the unit is on duty and available
Do not send the clinician into engagement until...
A dispatcher or patrol supervisor identifies an apparent behavioral-health crisis, welfare concern, suicidal or self-harm concern, or other call where a timely clinical assessment may add value.
Dispatch information and the assigned deputy assess the location and state that the scene is sufficiently secure for direct engagement.
The caller/person may benefit from voluntary assessment, crisis planning, referral, or a coordinated handoff.
Active violence, a weapon threat, an uncontained serious crime, or apparent medical instability is controlled, staged, or assigned to the appropriate primary response.

This proposal uses “clinician” for the Hartsmere crisis worker and “deputy” for the assigned CCSO deputy. “Clearance” means the deputy's current safety determination, not a promise that risk cannot change.


2. Authority, activation, and pre-shift readiness
Function
Accountable role and non-delegable boundary
Scene and enforcement
The deputy controls scene security, tactical decisions, enforcement action, use-of-force decisions, searches, restraints, evidence handling, pursuit, prisoner guarding, custody, and the legal decision to detain. The patrol supervisor directs law-enforcement supervision.
Clinical work
The clinician independently controls clinical assessment, clinical recommendations, clinical supervision, and clinical documentation. The Hartsmere Clinical Director directs clinical supervision. A deputy does not direct diagnosis, care recommendation, or the clinical note.
Coordination
The team shares only what is lawful, purpose-related, and the minimum reasonably necessary. Neither role has joint command over the other's decision rights.
Safety assurance
Wrenfield Associates reviews safety arrangements and reports advice to the Clinical Director. The governance committee oversees approval and review; neither directs live tactical or clinical decisions.

Dispatch and prioritization
At shift start, the patrol supervisor confirms that the paired unit is on duty and available; dispatch marks it available only after that confirmation. Dispatch sends eligible calls through normal channels and gives the team the address, caller safety information, known weapons or violence information available in CAD, medical flags, and any current service constraints. The dispatcher does not provide clinic-record access or assume clinical eligibility from a label alone.
If eligible calls compete, the patrol supervisor applies current safety risk, immediacy, availability, distance/ability to respond, and likely clinical utility, then tells dispatch the selected assignment. Dispatch communicates the assignment and continues to route unselected calls to ordinary patrol or the appropriate response. A supervisor may stage the clinician or decline co-response for the call.
Required pre-shift check
Who
Before dispatch marks availability
Deputy + clinician
Confirm pairing, radio/dispatch contact, a deputy-controlled emergency signal or radio procedure, vehicle readiness, protective/safety equipment, safe waiting location, and immediate deputy availability. The clinician does not rely solely on a personal phone to summon assistance.
Patrol supervisor + Dispatch Supervisor
Confirm the service window, unit availability, backup/EMS request route, transport options, call-routing limits, and method to announce a changed scene status.
Clinical Director/designee
Confirm the clinician is appropriately credentialed/competent for crisis work, has access to clinical supervision, and has the current paper/EHR documentation method.

If the clinician, deputy, paired vehicle, radio/dispatch contact, or required safety capability is unavailable, dispatch marks co-response unavailable. Ordinary patrol and normal clinical referral pathways continue; the clinician is never deployed alone.


3. Field procedure: arrival, engagement, disagreement, disposition
Step
Required action / completion point
1. Stage and clear
Deputy receives dispatch information, chooses staging, and assesses persons, exits, hazards, weapons, violence, and need for backup or EMS. The clinician remains with the deputy or at the agreed safe location. No solo contact at an unsecured scene and no separation without an explicit safety arrangement and immediate deputy availability.
2. Engage
After deputy clearance, explain roles and seek consent for clinical assessment when appropriate. Explain that clinical confidentiality has legally recognized limits and that a police-attended encounter cannot promise absolute secrecy. Existing law and CCSO policy govern body-worn camera use; the clinician cannot switch recording off or guarantee non-recording.
3. Assess and decide
Use voluntary, least-restrictive assessment, stabilization, referral, and transport where lawful and safe. For apparent overdose, serious injury, altered consciousness, or other medical instability, request EMS/emergency medical assessment; the clinician is not a substitute for medical care.
4. Change in safety
If violence, weapon threat, or uncontrolled hazard emerges, clinician immediately withdraws/moves to the designated safe location and communicates by radio/deputy emergency signal. Deputies manage the threat. The clinician re-enters only after renewed deputy clearance.
5. Close
Confirm disposition, transport responsibility, accepted handoff, required records, and whether any incident notification is due before the team returns available.

Detention and clinical disagreement
When detention is considered, the authorized deputy alone decides whether lawful grounds exist and independently articulates those grounds in the applicable law-enforcement record. Clinical input is relevant but a diagnosis, assessment, or recommendation is not detention authority. A clinician who objects may state an alternative recommendation and document the clinical objection in the clinic-controlled record; the objection does not veto a lawful detention.
When practicable, the deputy promptly consults the patrol supervisor and the clinician contacts clinical supervision. Consultation must not delay immediately necessary safety action or lawful custody action. Both accounts are preserved in their respective records; a material disagreement is flagged for routine joint review after the immediate event.
Disposition and accepted handoff
Path
Transport / minimum information / acceptance
Voluntary clinical or community care
Clinician arranges an appropriate voluntary transport option; deputy assists only within law and policy. Person remains a voluntary passenger or patient, not in law-enforcement custody. Clinician sends only necessary care/referral information with consent or another lawful basis. Handoff is complete when the receiving service confirms acceptance or the person receives the agreed referral/plan.
Emergency medical care
EMS provides or arranges medical transport. Deputy provides necessary safety/incident information to EMS; clinician provides necessary clinical information under applicable law. Handoff is complete when EMS or the emergency department accepts responsibility.
Lawful custody or emergency detention
Deputy retains custody and arranges transport under law and CCSO policy; clinician does not take custody. Deputy provides required custody/safety information and clinician provides only lawfully shareable necessary clinical information. Handoff is complete when the lawful receiving authority accepts custody or care and the deputy documents transfer.



4. Records, privacy, and the documentation transition
Clinical assessment and care documentation, including during ride-alongs, form part of the clinic-controlled clinical record. Dispatch, enforcement, force, detention, and other reportable police activity require the applicable separate law-enforcement record; the clinical note never substitutes for it, and a police record is not Hartsmere's treatment record. Access is role-based. Field papers/devices remain in the clinician's control and are not stored in the patrol vehicle except as a brief secured carry arrangement under the clinician's control.
State
Authoritative record and workable field method
Paper transition period
The authorized Hartsmere paper clinical chart is the single authoritative clinical record. Clinician completes the approved paper encounter note or approved temporary worksheet, safeguards it in a closed clinic-controlled carrier, and transfers it to the designated clinic records intake at the first practicable opportunity. The temporary worksheet is then incorporated into the chart or disposed of only under Hartsmere's authorized records schedule; it does not remain as a competing clinical record.
EHR end state
Hartsmere's electronic health record is the single authoritative clinical record. Clinician enters the encounter in the EHR using approved access. Any field aid is a controlled temporary capture and is reconciled to the EHR, then retained or securely destroyed only under the clinic's authorized records schedule.
EHR downtime
Use Hartsmere's approved secure downtime form or controlled temporary capture for essential information. Secure it, enter it into the EHR when service returns, and record/verify reconciliation. The temporary capture is then handled under the authorized records schedule.

Cutover control and disclosure
The Hartsmere Clinical Director makes one cutover decision, states the effective point in writing to clinicians, dispatch liaison, and patrol leadership, and designates a records lead for notes created around cutover. An encounter started before the effective point follows the paper procedure unless the records lead directs controlled migration; an encounter begun after follows the EHR procedure. The records lead resolves any duplicate or incomplete entry so only the designated authoritative record remains.
At initial clinical contact, seek consent for sharing when appropriate. Share only minimum necessary information for a lawful operational or care purpose. Imminent safety threats, abuse or neglect reporting duties, court process, and other legally required disclosures are handled under applicable law and policy. Suspected loss, misdirection, or unauthorized access is promptly reported through the applicable Hartsmere privacy/incident route and/or CCSO information-security route; preserve the item/system and notify the relevant supervisor.


5. Incident control, notifications, and service continuity
Event
Immediate route
Record and follow-up
Safety event, injury, threat, weapon event, force, custody issue, or material protocol departure
Deputy notifies patrol supervisor/dispatch by the urgent route; clinician notifies the Clinical Director or on-call clinical supervisor by the urgent route. Request backup/EMS as needed.
Each organization completes its applicable incident/reporting process promptly. Notify both owners when the event affects both roles; do not wait for governance review.
Privacy incident, lost/misdirected paper, device, or unauthorized access
Secure the material/device and promptly notify the clinician's clinical/privacy route and, where police information is involved, the deputy's CCSO route.
Use each applicable incident system and preserve facts needed for review. No blanket exchange of the underlying records occurs merely because an incident was reported.
Routine operational concern or non-material deviation
Tell the patrol supervisor and clinical supervisor before end of shift when practicable.
Log through the applicable local supervisory process for review at the next joint operating review.

Immediate pause / reassessment authority
The patrol supervisor may pause field deployment for a serious scene-safety event, inadequate law-enforcement support, unsafe vehicle/communications capability, or repeated operational failure. The Clinical Director may pause clinical participation for a serious clinical-safety event, inadequate clinical supervision/credentialing support, privacy or record-control failure, or repeated clinical protocol failure. Either owner promptly tells the other and dispatch. A pause suspends co-response only; normal patrol and ordinary clinic pathways continue. Restart requires both owners to document that the relevant control is restored; committee oversight does not replace either owner's immediate authority.
Minimum incident review
For a material cross-agency event, the Patrol Commander and Clinical Director request a focused review of actions, communications, documentation, and safeguards. Wrenfield Associates may advise the Clinical Director on safety safeguards. The review does not alter statutory duties, substitute for either organization's incident process, or decide live custody, force, or clinical care.
Field constraints to retain throughout a shift
Always
Never
Deputy and clinician use an agreed safe location and deputy-controlled emergency communication; dispatch is kept aware of a status change. The clinician may have a private clinical conversation only after explicit safety arrangement, with immediate deputy availability.
Do not assign the clinician searches, restraints, evidence handling, pursuit, prisoner guarding, tactical tasks, or enforcement functions. Do not leave the clinician for solo contact at an unsecured scene.
The assigned deputy remains subject to CCSO supervision; the clinician remains subject to Hartsmere clinical supervision. A supervisor may redirect a call to ordinary patrol, EMS, or another response.
Do not treat a clinical recommendation as a detention order; do not treat a detention decision as a clinical conclusion; do not create reciprocal full-record access.



6. Assurance, review, and approval decision
This is a controlled operational proposal. It does not promise arrest, force, hospitalization, recurrence, cost, or clinical outcomes. It will be assessed from records already created in normal operations, with clinical and law-enforcement access kept separate except for lawful minimum-necessary review information.
Proposed measure
Source owner / review use
Availability: scheduled window marked available, unavailable, or suspended; reason category where recorded
Dispatch Supervisor maintains dispatch availability information; Patrol Commander and Clinical Director review service coverage and constraints.
Process: dispatched co-response assignments, staging/declines, completed eligible contacts, consultation flags, and completed handoffs
Dispatch and applicable patrol records identify operational process; Hartsmere clinical records identify clinical-contact/handoff information. Owners use de-identified or minimum-necessary summaries.
Disposition: voluntary referral/transport, EMS transfer, or custody-related handoff category
Respective ordinary records; review checks completion of handoff, not whether a disposition caused a later outcome.
Safety and control: injuries, threats, force events, privacy incidents, material deviations, pauses, and corrective actions
Each organization's incident/supervisory records. Wrenfield may advise on the clinic safety review.

Interpretation and cadence
The Patrol Commander and Clinical Director receive a joint minimum-necessary operational summary every 60 days (a proposed operating parameter) and after any material cross-agency event. The Hartsmere Clinical Governance Committee receives the same 60-day governance summary and Wrenfield safety advice where requested. At each review, the Clinical Governance Committee and CCSO Patrol Commander jointly authorize continuation, modification, or closure within their respective authorities; the Clinical Director retains clinical controls. Local volume is limited, calls are selected for co-response, and there is no comparison baseline. Observations therefore describe operations and safeguards; they do not prove that the model caused an outcome.
Approval record
Decision maker
Decision
Name / signature / date
Hartsmere Clinical Governance Committee
Approve as written / decline
________________________________
CCSO Patrol Commander
Operational acceptance after committee approval
________________________________
Hartsmere Clinical Director
Clinical ownership, readiness, and records acceptance
________________________________
Wrenfield Associates
Safety review advice provided to Clinical Director
________________________________

Approval activates only at the effective point stated in Section 1. Any local policy or legal requirement that is more protective or controlling remains applicable; this instrument does not create a new detention authority or waive existing records, privacy, camera, force, or reporting requirements.

criteria.description: 所需的 DOCX 存在于确切的文件名下，并作为结构有效的 Word 文档打开。
criteria.evidence: 提交的文件和DOCX包结构。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认hartsmere_coresponse_proposal.docx存在于提交根目录，可以打开，并且包含可读的文档内容。

original.criterion: The required DOCX exists under the exact filename and opens as a structurally valid Word document.
original.evidence: Submitted file and DOCX package structure.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that hartsmere_coresponse_proposal.docx is present at the submission root, can be opened, and contains readable document content.

criteria.description: 完整的文件，包括批准材料，不超过六页，并且不包含附录。
criteria.evidence: 最后主要部分之后呈现的文档分页和内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准办公套件渲染 DOCX。清点所有页数并确认主计划之后没有附录或附录等效材料。

original.criterion: The complete document, including approval material, renders in no more than six pages and contains no appendix.
original.evidence: Rendered document pagination and content following the final main section.
original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX using a standard office suite. Count all pages and confirm there is no appendix or appendix-equivalent material after the main plan.

criteria.description: 该文件呈现为受控的、可供批准的操作工具，确定其目的、操作状态或有效点、负责的组织所有者和批准权限。
criteria.evidence: 记录控制、目的、所有权和批准内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找足够的控制信息，以便委员会可以批准该仪器，并且现场用户可以知道它何时以及在谁的授权下应用；不需要确切的标题名称。

original.criterion: The document is presented as a controlled, approval-ready operating instrument, identifying its purpose, operating status or effective point, responsible organizational owners, and approval authority.
original.evidence: Document control, purpose, ownership, and approval content.
original.grader_hint: Look for enough control information that the committee could approve the instrument and field users could tell when and under whose authority it applies; exact heading names are not required.

criteria.description: 拟议的部署提供了一个明确且内部一致的周五和周六夜间服务窗口，而不是让运营时间悬而未决。
criteria.evidence: 人员配置建议、部署描述和操作流程。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受任何专业上可行的夜班窗口。验证时间表出现的位置是否使用相同的日期和时间。

original.criterion: The proposed deployment gives one definite and internally consistent Friday-and-Saturday night service window rather than leaving operating hours unresolved.
original.evidence: Staffing proposal, deployment description, and operating workflow.
original.grader_hint: Accept any professionally plausible night-shift window. Verify that the same days and hours are used wherever the schedule appears.

criteria.description: 该计划将服务范围和预期呼叫人群定义得足够窄，以便调度员和主管能够将协同响应工作与普通巡逻、常规诊所外展和紧急医疗响应区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 范围、资格、调度和排除语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估现场读者是否能够在不询问作者的情况下判断团队要处理什么和不应该处理什么。

original.criterion: The plan defines the service scope and intended call population narrowly enough for dispatchers and supervisors to distinguish co-response work from ordinary patrol, routine clinic outreach, and emergency medical response.
original.evidence: Scope, eligibility, dispatch, and exclusion language.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether a field reader can tell what the team is and is not meant to handle without asking the author.

criteria.description: 所规定的目标是可操作的和相称的，例如更安全的评估、适当的转诊和更明确的协调，而没有承诺现有证据无法证实的临床或执行结果。
criteria.evidence: 目的、目标和预期收益声明。
criteria.grader_hint: 信用目标被界定为目标或服务功能。不要相信该模型将减少逮捕、强迫、住院、复发或费用的无根据的保证。

original.criterion: The stated objectives are operational and proportionate, such as safer assessment, appropriate referral, and clearer coordination, without promising clinical or enforcement outcomes the available evidence cannot establish.
original.grader_hint: Credit objectives framed as aims or service functions. Do not credit unsupported assurances that the model will reduce arrests, force, hospitalization, recurrence, or costs.

criteria.description: 所有定量的事实声明仅限于每周提供的大约二十个电话和规定的日期，或者明确标记建议的操作参数而不是历史事实。
criteria.evidence: 文档中的每个数字陈述。
criteria.grader_hint: 走所有的数字。如果标记为计划参数，则可以选择建议的时间、审查间隔和操作时间限制；历史趋势、结果率、成本、节省或人员配置事实不得捏造。

original.criterion: All quantitative factual claims are limited to the supplied approximately twenty calls per week and stated dates, or are clearly labeled proposed operating parameters rather than historical facts.
original.evidence: Every numerical statement in the document.
original.grader_hint: Walk all numbers. Proposed hours, review intervals, and operational time limits may be selected if labeled as plan parameters; historical trends, outcome rates, costs, savings, or staffing facts must not be invented.

criteria.description: 这种治理模式将执法监管、临床监管、安全审查和委员会监督分开，没有形成模糊的联合指挥安排。
criteria.evidence: 角色、责任、升级和治理规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的责任职能和明确的升级目标。共同合作是可以接受的，但操作和临床的权力链必须保持清晰易懂。

original.criterion: The governance model separates law-enforcement supervision, clinical supervision, safety review, and committee oversight without creating a vague joint-command arrangement.
original.evidence: Roles, responsibilities, escalation, and governance provisions.
original.grader_hint: Look for distinct accountable functions and clear escalation destinations. Shared cooperation is acceptable, but operational and clinical chains of authority must remain intelligible.

criteria.description: 该计划将现场安全、战术决策、执法行动和使用武力决策分配给执法部门。
criteria.evidence: 角色和场景命令语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 同等措辞是可以接受的。不得向临床医生指派战术指挥权或负责决定如何使用武力。

original.criterion: The plan assigns scene security, tactical decisions, enforcement action, and use-of-force decisions to law enforcement.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent wording is acceptable. The clinician must not be assigned tactical command or responsibility for deciding how force is used.

criteria.description: 该计划保留了临床工作人员的独立临床评估、临床建议和临床记录的责任。
criteria.evidence: 临床角色和决策权语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认副手不指导诊断、治疗建议或临床记录，并且临床结论仍然归因于临床医生。

original.criterion: The plan preserves the clinic worker's independent clinical assessment, clinical recommendations, and clinical documentation responsibilities.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the deputy does not direct a diagnosis, treatment recommendation, or clinical note and that clinical conclusions remain attributable to the clinician.

criteria.description: 当考虑拘留时，该计划让授权代表负责法律决定并独立于临床医生的意见阐明合法理由。
criteria.evidence: 拘留、拘留、分歧和报告规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 将临床输入视为相关但不视为拘留的法律授权的信用语言。该计划不应意味着仅凭诊断即可产生拘留权。

original.criterion: When detention is considered, the plan makes the authorized deputy responsible for the legal decision and for articulating lawful grounds independently of the clinician's opinion.
original.evidence: Detention, custody, disagreement, and reporting provisions.
original.grader_hint: Credit language that treats clinical input as relevant but not as the legal authorization for detention. The plan should not imply that a diagnosis alone creates detention authority.

criteria.description: 分歧过程允许临床医生陈述并记录反对意见或替代建议，而无需给予临床医生对合法拘留的否决权。
criteria.evidence: 分歧和文件程序。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找两半：有意义地保留临床异议，并且不将合法监护权转移给临床医生。

original.criterion: The disagreement process allows the clinician to state and document an objection or alternative recommendation without giving the clinician a veto over a lawful detention.
original.grader_hint: Look for both halves: meaningful preservation of clinical dissent and no transfer of legal custody authority to the clinician.

criteria.description: 分歧程序在可行时提供了及时的监督或临床咨询途径，同时明确咨询不会延迟立即做出必要的安全或合法监护决定。
criteria.evidence: 升级顺序和紧急行动语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 该计划应将可协商的争议与直接威胁区分开来。需要委员会或管理层在现场长时间批准的流程在操作上是不够的。

original.criterion: The disagreement procedure provides a prompt supervisory or clinical consultation route when practicable while making clear that consultation does not delay an immediately necessary safety or lawful custody decision.
original.grader_hint: The plan should distinguish a consultable dispute from an immediate threat. A process that requires prolonged committee or management approval at the scene is not operationally adequate.

criteria.description: 该计划指出，临床评估和护理文件构成诊所控制的临床记录的一部分，包括在乘车期间。
criteria.evidence: 记录所有权和临床文件规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受将诊所标识为临床记录的保管人或所有者的同等语言。存放在巡逻车中或参与联合应对不得将监管权移交给执法部门。

original.criterion: The plan states that clinical assessment and care documentation form part of the clinic-controlled clinical record, including during ride-alongs.
original.evidence: Records ownership and clinical documentation provisions.
original.grader_hint: Accept equivalent language identifying the clinic as custodian or owner of the clinical record. Storage in a patrol vehicle or participation in a joint response must not transfer custody to law enforcement.

criteria.description: 该计划要求代表们填写适用于派遣、执法、武力、拘留或其他应报告的警察活动的执法记录，与临床记录分开。
criteria.evidence: 执法文件要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认临床记录不被视为替代所需的警方报告，并且警方记录不作为诊所的治疗记录。

original.criterion: The plan requires deputies to complete the applicable law-enforcement record for dispatch, enforcement, force, detention, or other reportable police activity, separate from the clinical note.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the clinical note is not treated as a substitute for a required police report and that police records are not presented as the clinic's treatment record.

criteria.description: 合作伙伴之间的信息共享仅限于合法的运营或护理目的以及该目的合理所需的最低限度的信息。
criteria.evidence: 隐私、披露、简报和交接语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求目的限制和最低限度的必要纪律，而不是全面覆盖对完整记录的相互访问。

original.criterion: Information sharing between the partners is limited to a lawful operational or care purpose and to the minimum information reasonably necessary for that purpose.
original.evidence: Privacy, disclosure, briefing, and handoff language.
original.grader_hint: Look for purpose limitation and minimum-necessary discipline rather than blanket reciprocal access to complete records.

criteria.description: 该计划涉及同意问题，并解释说，保密性具有法律认可的限制，但并未承诺在警察参与的冲突中绝对保密。
criteria.evidence: 初步联系、同意和隐私说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 相信在适当的时候寻求同意并解释可预见的信息共享限制的操作方法。它不需要提供法律教程。

original.criterion: The plan addresses consent and explains that confidentiality has legally recognized limits without promising absolute secrecy at a police-attended encounter.
original.evidence: Initial contact, consent, and privacy explanation.
original.grader_hint: Credit an operational approach for seeking consent when appropriate and explaining foreseeable information-sharing limits. It need not provide a legal tutorial.

criteria.description: 该计划认识到迫在眉睫的安全威胁、滥用或忽视报告义务、法庭程序或其他法律要求的披露将根据适用的法律和政策进行处理。
criteria.evidence: 保密例外和升级语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 同等类别是可以接受的。当法律要求披露时，该文件不应要求工作人员隐瞒信息。

original.criterion: The plan recognizes that imminent safety threats, abuse or neglect reporting duties, court process, or other legally required disclosures are handled under applicable law and policy.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent categories are acceptable. The document should not require staff to withhold information when disclosure is legally mandated.

criteria.description: 该运营计划通过现有的执法法律和政策解决佩戴式摄像头的使用问题，同时避免保证临床医生可以关闭记录或保证不会记录遭遇。
criteria.evidence: 录音、隐私和场景练习规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 归功于简洁的运营边界。不需要详细的相机教程或发明本地相机规则。

original.criterion: The operating plan addresses body-worn camera use through existing law-enforcement law and policy while avoiding any assurance that the clinician can switch recording off or guarantee that an encounter will not be recorded.
original.grader_hint: Credit a concise operational boundary. Do not require a detailed camera tutorial or invented local camera rule.

criteria.description: 该计划需要派遣信息和副手评估，以便在诊所工作人员接近或开始直接参与之前确定现场安全。
criteria.evidence: 调度、到达、集结和参与工作流程。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找真正的许可或安全评估门，而不仅仅是安全很重要的一般性声明。

original.criterion: The plan requires dispatch information and deputy assessment to establish scene safety before the clinic worker approaches or begins direct engagement.
original.evidence: Dispatch, arrival, staging, and engagement workflow.
original.grader_hint: Look for a genuine clearance or safety-assessment gate, not merely a general statement that safety is important.

criteria.description: 如果出现暴力、武器威胁或其他不受控制的危险，诊所工作人员会撤离或转移到指定的安全地点，同时代表人员处理威胁，只有在重新获得许可后才能重新进入。
criteria.evidence: 暴力和紧急程序。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有三个功能要素都应该存在：临床医生脱离、执法威胁管理以及重新进入之前的肯定许可。

original.criterion: If violence, a weapon threat, or another uncontrolled hazard emerges, the clinic worker withdraws or moves to a designated safe location while deputies manage the threat, with re-entry only after renewed clearance.
original.grader_hint: All three functional elements should be present: clinician disengagement, law-enforcement threat management, and affirmative clearance before re-entry.

criteria.description: 该团队有一种实用的方法来呼叫紧急援助并传达现场状态的变化，而无需仅仅依赖临床医生的个人电话。
criteria.evidence: 通讯、设备和应急程序。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受无线电、副控制的紧急信号、调度协议或在活跃场景中起作用的等效安排。

original.criterion: The team has a practical way to summon urgent assistance and communicate a change in scene status without relying solely on the clinician's personal phone.
original.grader_hint: Accept a radio, deputy-controlled emergency signal, dispatch protocol, or equivalent arrangement that works during an active scene.

criteria.description: 诊所工作人员不得在不安全的场景中进行单独接触，并且在没有明确的安全安排的情况下不得与指定的副手分开。
criteria.evidence: 配对、移动和场景接触规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 该计划可能允许在安全的情况下进行临床私人谈话，但它必须保持副手的即时可用性并避免无支持的单独部署。

original.criterion: The clinic worker is not left to make solo contact at an unsecured scene and does not separate from the assigned deputy without an explicit safety arrangement.
original.grader_hint: The plan may permit clinically private conversation when safe, but it must preserve immediate deputy availability and avoid unsupported solo deployment.

criteria.description: 诊所工作人员没有被分配搜查、限制、证据处理、追捕、囚犯看守或其他执行职能。
criteria.evidence: 角色限制和现场程序。
criteria.grader_hint: 相信明确的边界涵盖了这些功能，或者通过等效的明确排除。

original.criterion: The clinic worker is not assigned searches, restraints, evidence handling, pursuit, prisoner guarding, or other enforcement functions.
original.grader_hint: Credit an explicit boundary covering these functions collectively or through equivalent clear exclusions.

criteria.description: 调度资格标准足够具体，可以识别行为健康评估可能会增加价值的呼叫，并确认共同响应小组是否值班且可用。
criteria.evidence: 调度和激活标准。
criteria.grader_hint: 例子可能包括明显的危机、福利问题或重复的危机接触，但该标准必须是可用的，而不是不受限制的“所有行为健康呼叫”规则。

original.criterion: Dispatch eligibility criteria are specific enough to identify calls where behavioral-health assessment may add value and to confirm that the co-response unit is on duty and available.
original.grader_hint: Examples may include apparent crisis, welfare concerns, or repeat crisis contacts, but the standard must be usable rather than an unrestricted 'all behavioral-health calls' rule.

criteria.description: 该计划确定了在临床医生参与之前需要再次响应或上演的呼叫，包括主动暴力或武器、未受遏制的严重犯罪以及明显的医疗不稳定。
criteria.evidence: 排除、分期和替代反应规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 危险得到控制后临床医生方可加入；该计划不需要永久排除该人以后的临床接触。

original.criterion: The plan identifies calls that require another response or staging before clinician engagement, including active violence or weapons, an uncontained serious crime, and apparent medical instability.
original.grader_hint: The clinician may join after hazards are controlled; the plan need not permanently exclude the person from later clinical contact.

criteria.description: 当符合条件的呼叫竞争时，指定的操作角色会应用规定的安全和需求因素来确定部署的优先级，并通过调度传达最终的分配结果。
criteria.evidence: 优先级和调度规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用当前风险、即时性、可用性和可能的临床实用性等因素来寻找可靠的优先顺序。不需要发明调度代码。

original.criterion: When eligible calls compete, a named operational role applies stated safety-and-need factors to prioritize deployment and communicates the resulting assignment through dispatch.
original.grader_hint: Look for accountable prioritization using factors such as current risk, immediacy, availability, and likely clinical utility. No invented dispatch code is required.

criteria.description: 响应工作流程有利于在合法和安全的情况下进行自愿评估、稳定、转介和运输，而不会在满足拘留标准时强制要求自愿解决。
criteria.evidence: 评估和处置工作流程。
criteria.grader_hint: 该计划应保留限制最少的选项，同时承认合法的紧急行动。

original.criterion: The response workflow favors voluntary assessment, stabilization, referral, and transport when lawful and safe, without making voluntary resolution mandatory when detention criteria are met.
original.grader_hint: The plan should preserve least-restrictive options while recognizing lawful emergency action.

criteria.description: 明显的服药过量、严重受伤、意识改变或其他医疗不稳定会引发紧急医疗评估，而不是依靠危机工作人员来替代医疗护理。
criteria.evidence: 医疗紧急情况和排除程序。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果计划明确将紧急医疗需求转至 EMS 或急诊科，则同等医疗危险信号是可以接受的。

original.criterion: Apparent overdose, serious injury, altered consciousness, or other medical instability triggers emergency medical assessment rather than relying on the crisis worker as a substitute for medical care.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent medical red flags are acceptable if the plan clearly routes urgent medical needs to EMS or an emergency department.

criteria.description: 每个处理路径都确定谁安排或提供交通、该人携带哪些信息以及什么构成可接受的移交。
criteria.evidence: 处置、运输、转介和移交规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 审查自愿护理、紧急医疗护理和监护相关目的地（如果适用）。目的地名称不是必需的，但责任和完成标准是必需的。

original.criterion: Each disposition path identifies who arranges or provides transport, what information accompanies the person, and what constitutes an accepted handoff.
original.evidence: Disposition, transport, referral, and handoff provisions.
original.grader_hint: Review voluntary care, emergency medical care, and custody-related destinations as applicable. A destination name is not required, but responsibility and completion criteria are.

criteria.description: 该计划在整个运输和交接过程中保留了自愿乘客或患者与执法拘留人员之间的区别。
criteria.evidence: 运输、约束、监护和交接语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 不得将临床医生描述为采取合法监护，也不得以错误暗示拘留的方式描述自愿转运。

original.criterion: The plan preserves the distinction between a voluntary passenger or patient and a person in law-enforcement custody throughout transport and handoff.
original.evidence: Transport, restraint, custody, and handoff language.
original.grader_hint: The clinician must not be portrayed as taking legal custody, and voluntary transport must not be described in a way that falsely implies detention.

criteria.description: 轮班前检查使副手、诊所工作人员、主管和调度人员在可用性、通信、安全设备、交通选项和已知服务限制方面保持一致。
criteria.evidence: 换档启动程序。
criteria.grader_hint: 归功于紧凑但操作完整的简报或准备情况检查。它不需要指定系统点击路径。

original.criterion: A pre-shift check aligns the deputy, clinic worker, supervisor, and dispatch on availability, communications, safety equipment, transport options, and known service constraints.
original.grader_hint: Credit a compact but operationally complete briefing or readiness check. It need not specify system click paths.

criteria.description: 人员配备要求拥有适当资格的诊所人员，能够接受临床监督，并选择或介绍一名在执法监督下执行任务的副手。
criteria.evidence: 资格、准备情况和监督规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 不需要发明的认证头衔。寻找适合角色的能力并确定双方的监督支持。

original.criterion: The staffing provisions require appropriately credentialed clinic personnel with access to clinical supervision and a deputy selected or briefed for the assignment under law-enforcement supervision.
original.grader_hint: Do not require an invented certification title. Look for role-appropriate competence and identified supervisory support on both sides.

criteria.description: 如果诊所工作人员、指派的副手、车辆或所需的安全能力不可用，该计划会定义后备方案，不会单独派出临床医生，也不会暗示普通巡逻响应会停止。
criteria.evidence: 人员配置失误和服务连续性程序。
criteria.grader_hint: 防御性后备措施可能会暂停共同应对，同时继续进行标准巡逻和正常的临床转诊途径。

original.criterion: If the clinic worker, assigned deputy, vehicle, or required safety capability is unavailable, the plan defines a fallback and does not send the clinician alone or imply that ordinary patrol response stops.
original.grader_hint: A defensible fallback may suspend co-response while standard patrol and normal clinical referral pathways continue.

criteria.description: 安全事件、伤害、威胁、武力、隐私事件和材料协议偏离均通过适用的执法和临床事件系统迅速进行处理，紧急通知与常规审查有所区别。
criteria.evidence: 事件报告和通知规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 该计划不应将所有事件归入一个合作伙伴的流程中，也不应将报告推迟到定期委员会会议。

original.criterion: Safety events, injuries, threats, force, privacy incidents, and material protocol departures are routed promptly through the applicable law-enforcement and clinical incident systems, with urgent notifications distinguished from routine review.
original.grader_hint: The plan should not collapse all incidents into one partner's process or defer reporting until a periodic committee meeting.

criteria.description: 记录程序明确涵盖纸质记录过渡期和电子记录结束状态，并且现场工作流程在每个阶段仍然可行。
criteria.evidence: 过渡、文档和工作流程规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 在每个阶段下追踪一次遭遇。临床医生必须在这两者中拥有可用的捕获、保护和归档流程。

original.criterion: The records procedure explicitly covers both the paper-note transition period and the electronic-record end state, and the field workflow remains workable in each phase.
original.grader_hint: Trace one encounter under each phase. The clinician must have a usable capture, safeguarding, and filing process in both.

criteria.description: 对于每个过渡阶段，该计划都会确定一份权威的临床记录，并防止不受控制的重复记录成为相互竞争的临床记录。
criteria.evidence: 记录事实来源和转换控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 割接前后的权威媒体可能有所不同。只有在其转让和处置受到控制的情况下，临时票据才是可接受的。

original.criterion: For each transition phase, the plan identifies one authoritative clinical record and prevents uncontrolled duplicate notes from becoming competing clinical records.
original.grader_hint: The authoritative medium may differ before and after cutover. Temporary notes are acceptable only if their transfer and disposition are controlled.

criteria.description: 向电子记录的转移具有可靠的切换决定、传达的有效点以及解决围绕切换创建的注释的方法。
criteria.evidence: 割接和治理规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 不需要日历日期。归功于基于角色的批准和沟通触发器，避免每个员工独立选择何时切换。

original.criterion: The move to the electronic record has an accountable cutover decision, a communicated effective point, and a method for resolving notes created around the cutover.
original.grader_hint: Do not require a calendar date. Credit a role-based approval and communication trigger that avoids each worker choosing independently when to switch.

criteria.description: 最终状态程序包括电子系统停机方法，该方法可以安全地捕获基本信息，并在服务恢复时输入或协调这些信息。
criteria.evidence: 停机时间和协调程序。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找安全的临时捕获、稍后输入以及检查核对是否已完成。

original.criterion: The end-state procedure includes an electronic-system downtime method that captures essential information securely and enters or reconciles it when service returns.
original.grader_hint: Look for secure temporary capture, later entry, and a check that reconciliation was completed.

criteria.description: 纸质笔记和临时工作表仅根据诊所授权的记录时间表进行保护、转移、保留或销毁，而不是非正式地丢弃或指定一个发明的保留期限。
criteria.evidence: 纸张处理、转移、保留和销毁规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 引用诊所批准的保留和安全销毁控制措施。该文件不应发明特定司法管辖区的天数或年数。

original.criterion: Paper notes and temporary worksheets are secured, transferred, retained, or destroyed only under the clinic's authorized records schedule rather than discarded informally or assigned an invented retention period.
original.evidence: Paper handling, transfer, retention, and destruction provisions.
original.grader_hint: Credit reference to the clinic's approved retention and secure-destruction controls. The document should not invent a jurisdiction-specific number of days or years.

criteria.description: 临床和执法记录具有基于角色的访问、现场安全处理以及针对可疑丢失、误导或未经授权的访问的明确路线。
criteria.evidence: 访问控制、现场安全和违规响应语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找涵盖纸质和电子信息的实用控制措施，而不需要技术系统说明。

original.criterion: Clinical and law-enforcement records have role-based access, secure handling in the field, and a defined route for suspected loss, misdirection, or unauthorized access.
original.evidence: Access control, field security, and breach response language.
original.grader_hint: Look for practical controls covering both paper and electronic information without requiring technical system instructions.

criteria.description: 评估框架使用可获取的流程、处置、安全和服务可用性度量以及定义的所有者或源记录，而不是仅仅依赖印象。
criteria.evidence: 监测和评估规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 示例包括部署、部署、完成的交接、受伤、部队事件、拒绝响应和覆盖范围。仅信用措施可以从普通诊所或执法记录中得出。

original.criterion: The evaluation framework uses obtainable process, disposition, safety, and service-availability measures with defined owners or source records rather than relying on impressions alone.
original.grader_hint: Examples include deployments, dispositions, completed handoffs, injuries, force events, declined responses, and coverage. Credit only measures that can plausibly be derived from ordinary clinic or law-enforcement records.

criteria.description: 评估语言承认局部体积小、选择效应和缺乏比较基线，因此避免将试点观察结果作为因果关系的证据。
criteria.evidence: 数据限制和评估解释。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找对委员会可能推断的内容的明确限制，而不仅仅是每周大约发生二十个电话的声明。

original.criterion: The evaluation language acknowledges the small local volume, selection effects, and lack of a comparison baseline, and therefore avoids presenting pilot observations as proof of causation.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit limitation on what the committee may infer, not merely the statement that approximately twenty calls occur each week.

criteria.description: 该计划设定了明确的运营审查节奏，并确定哪些治理角色收到结果并授权继续、修改或关闭。
criteria.evidence: 审查时间表和治理决策点。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果表述一致并将决定分配给适当的临床和执法机构，任何比例的节奏都是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The plan sets a definite operational review cadence and identifies which governance roles receive results and authorize continuation, modification, or closure.
original.evidence: Review schedule and governance decision points.
original.grader_hint: Any proportionate cadence is acceptable if it is stated consistently and assigns decisions to appropriate clinical and law-enforcement authorities.

criteria.description: 该计划定义了严重安全事件、人员配备或监督不足、方案重复失败或无法使用的临床记录流程的立即暂停或重新评估触发器。
criteria.evidence: 暂停、暂停和纠正措施规定。
criteria.grader_hint: 触发器应保护员工和服务用户，而不意味着任何微小的偏差都会自动终止程序。

original.criterion: The plan defines immediate pause or reassessment triggers for serious safety events, inadequate staffing or supervision, repeated protocol failure, or an unusable clinical-record process.
original.grader_hint: The triggers should protect staff and service users without implying that any minor deviation automatically terminates the program.

criteria.description: 临床、法律和操作术语对于没有临床背景的巡视审查人员来说是简洁易懂的，同时对于临床治理审查来说仍然足够精确。
criteria.evidence: 整个文档的语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估上下文中的术语。必要的术语可以进行简短的定义，但无法解释的专业速记或过于简化的临床声明不应获得完全认可。

spec.professional_context: A county patrol supervisor is preparing an approval-ready co-response operating model for a clinic governance committee after an earlier safety-based rejection. The plan must establish practical clinical, law-enforcement, records, and scene-safety boundaries despite limited local data and a clinical documentation system in transition.
difficulty_sources: Establishing clear decision rights across law-enforcement and clinical chains of authority.
Designing a safe field workflow that remains useful for both routine crises and rapidly escalating scenes.
Supporting both paper and electronic clinical-record states without duplicate sources of truth.
Producing an approval-ready plan from thin local demand information without overstating benefits.
Writing for mixed clinical and patrol audiences within a six-page limit.

reference_material.reason: The task intentionally relies on occupational knowledge. No private local codes, templates, policies, datasets, or answer-bearing references may be introduced.

gold_document_specification.core_verdict: Produce an approval-ready co-response proposal and operating plan that makes the service feasible only within explicit, conservative boundaries for scene safety, legal authority, clinical independence, records custody, and transition control.
operating_parameters: Select one concrete Friday-and-Saturday night service window and use it consistently.
Define the proposal as one clinic crisis worker paired with one patrol unit during the selected window.
Treat the supplied weekly call figure as context rather than evidence of demand trends or program effectiveness.
Do not add historical outcomes, cost estimates, savings, staffing guarantees, research findings, or purported local legal citations.
decision_rights: Law enforcement controls scene security, tactical action, force, searches, restraints, evidence, pursuit, custody, and the legal decision to detain.
The clinician controls clinical assessment, recommendations, clinical supervision, and clinical documentation.
A deputy considering detention must articulate lawful grounds independently; a clinical diagnosis or recommendation is not itself detention authority.
Clinical disagreement must be heard and documented but cannot veto a lawful detention.
Consultation should be available when practicable, but urgent safety or lawful custody action is not delayed.
The safety adviser reviews safeguards but does not acquire field command, record custody, detention authority, or approval authority.
records_model: Clinical material belongs in the clinic-controlled clinical record; police material belongs in the applicable law-enforcement record.
Neither record substitutes for the other, and blanket reciprocal access is not permitted.
Information sharing is purpose-limited and minimum necessary, with consent sought when appropriate and lawful exceptions recognized.
Existing law and policy govern body-worn cameras; the clinician cannot promise that recording will stop.
During the transition, define an authoritative paper clinical record and controlled transfer of temporary notes.
After cutover, define the electronic clinical record as authoritative and include secure downtime capture, later entry, and reconciliation.
Assign an accountable cutover decision and handle records created around cutover without duplicate sources of truth.
Use approved retention and secure-destruction controls without inventing a retention period.
Apply role-based access, secure field handling, and incident reporting for lost or misdirected information.
field_workflow: Create usable eligibility, dispatch, prioritization, and availability checks.
Require staging or another primary response for active violence, weapons, uncontrolled serious crime, and medical instability.
Require deputy assessment and scene clearance before clinician engagement.
Keep the clinician paired with or immediately supported by the deputy; do not authorize unsupported solo scene contact.
On renewed violence or hazard, have the clinician withdraw to safety, law enforcement manage the threat, and require renewed clearance before re-entry.
Provide a robust emergency communication method that does not depend only on a personal telephone.
Favor voluntary and least-restrictive outcomes when lawful and safe while preserving emergency detention and medical-response routes.
Distinguish voluntary status from custody and identify transport, accompanying information, and accepted-handoff responsibility for each disposition.
Do not use the clinician as a substitute for emergency medical assessment or assign enforcement functions to the clinician.
staffing_and_readiness: Require role-appropriate credentialing or competence and clinical supervision for the clinic worker.
Place the assigned deputy under law-enforcement supervision and ensure assignment-specific briefing or preparation.
Use a pre-shift readiness check covering availability, communications, equipment, dispatch awareness, transport options, and service constraints.

If essential staff, vehicle, communications, or safety capability is unavailable, suspend co-response or use a defined fallback while normal patrol response continues; never deploy the clinician alone.
incidents_and_assurance: Route safety events, injuries, threats, force, privacy incidents, and material departures through each applicable incident system.
Distinguish immediate notification from routine review.
Define proportionate process, disposition, availability, and safety measures obtainable from ordinary records.
State that limited volume, selection effects, and no comparison baseline prevent causal claims.
Set a definite review cadence and assign continuation, modification, or closure decisions to appropriate governance roles.
Include pause or reassessment triggers for severe safety events, inadequate support, repeated protocol failure, or unusable record controls.
usability: Fit all material within six rendered pages without appendices.
Use concise operational language understandable to patrol personnel and credible to clinical reviewers.
Keep background and legal exposition brief; devote most space to responsibilities, triggers, actions, exceptions, and decision points.
Make field procedures and governance decisions easy to locate and reuse.
Include enough document-control and approval information for governance adoption without relying on a later unwritten procedure.

gold_validation.offline_build: Create and render the reference DOCX using Python office libraries and LibreOffice or equivalent offline tooling, then inspect pagination, headings, tables, text, and package validity.
gold_validation.rubric_walkthrough: Trace the reference solution through dispatch, arrival, safe engagement, voluntary disposition, medical emergency, detention over clinical objection, a scene becoming violent, paper-note operation, electronic-record operation, system downtime, an incident report, and governance review. Confirm that each path identifies authority, documentation, communication, and completion conditions.
gold_validation.reachability_check: All required substantive rules are mainstream professional knowledge for police supervision and behavioral-health co-response governance. No score depends on a private code, unseen template, exact local policy citation, or invented factual result.
gold_validation.space_check: The required operating rules can fit within six pages at normal professional document density using concise prose, responsibility tables, and workflow controls without appendices.

deliverables.description: Approval-ready co-response proposal and field operating plan for Friday and Saturday night deployment of a clinic crisis worker with a patrol unit.
constraints: Must be written to the top level of the working directory using the exact filename hartsmere_coresponse_proposal.docx.
Must not exceed six rendered pages.
Must address both the paper-record transition period and the electronic-record end state.
Must be usable by clinical governance reviewers and patrol personnel without becoming a behavioral-health tutorial or legal memorandum.

original_instruction:
You are Sgt. Odile Zubair, the patrol supervisor preparing Corriewood County Sheriff’s Office’s only written submission for Hartsmere Clinic’s March clinical governance meeting. Patrol handles about twenty behavioral-health calls in a typical week, but the clinic has no clinician available after 6 p.m. The committee rejected a ride-along arrangement two years ago because it was not satisfied about staff safety. Emeka Coutinho has asked for a proposal it can approve as written for one Hartsmere crisis worker to ride in a patrol unit on Friday and Saturday nights, with Wrenfield Associates reviewing the safety arrangements for the clinic. The operating model must work in Corriewood County under the legal and professional boundaries applicable as of February 15, 2026. This year the clinic is moving its community team from paper clinical notes to its electronic health record, but the patrol launch may occur before the change is complete, so the document has to remain operable during the transition and after cutover. The committee also wants no ambiguity about clinical-record ownership, disagreements when a deputy believes detention is lawful but the clinician objects, or what happens if a scene becomes violent. Those issues need to be settled in the operating plan rather than deferred to later policy writing. Prepare `hartsmere_coresponse_proposal.docx`, combining the approval proposal and the field operating plan in no more than six pages, with no appendices. Define a complete operating model that supervisors, deputies, dispatch personnel, clinic workers, and clinical governance reviewers can use without contacting you for clarification. The committee members understand clinical governance, while several patrol reviewers have no clinical background; keep it accessible to both groups without turning it into introductory behavioral-health training or a legal memorandum. Treat the twenty-call figure and the prior rejection as limited context only: do not invent call trends, outcome rates, costs, savings, staffing availability, or research findings. Put the finished file at the top level of the working directory using exactly the filename above. It must be ready for Emeka’s packet by March 6, 2026.

---
